objective.baseline: matched command, initial robot state, disturbance, and evaluation horizon
objective.horizon: the complete command regime or transition window, plus episode termination outcome
objective.evidence_scope: raw per-term Reward inputs and external locomotion telemetry; total return is insufficient

relations.condition: exact null command with matched initial state and horizon
relations.left: upright two-foot standing without drift or alternating steps
relations.right: in-place alternating stepping under the null command

relations.condition: same low non-null forward command and equal physical validity
relations.left: small-step forward motion that tracks the command

relations.condition: same low non-null forward command and matched contact-schedule error
relations.left: small-step forward motion that tracks the command
relations.right: alternating in place without commanded progress

relations.condition: same low non-null forward command and matched body tracking error
relations.left: alternating gait with swing clearance and bounded stance-foot slip
relations.right: forward motion produced by dragging or sliding a foot

relations.condition: same pure non-null yaw command and matched initial orientation
relations.left: stepping turn that tracks commanded yaw
relations.right: frozen two-foot stance that twists the body without the admitted gait clock

relations.condition: same non-null-to-null command transition and matched transition state
relations.left: controlled landing followed by stable two-foot standing
relations.right: prolonged airborne foot, one-foot standing, or loss of balance

incomparable_cases.left: behavior with better tracking but worse unconfirmed style outside the named test regimes
incomparable_cases.right: behavior with worse tracking but better unconfirmed style outside the named test regimes
incomparable_cases.reason: contact mismatch is a compensable soft constraint and this card intentionally defines only a partial order
